parties: Aruna Bhagwan Advani | Ador Welding Limited
headline: Aruna Bhagwan Advani files SEBI Takeover Regulation 31(4) disclosure for substantial acquisition in Ador Welding Limited
sum: Aruna Bhagwan Advani has made a regulated disclosure under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations 2011, Regulation 31(4), signalling a material change in shareholding in listed industrial company Ador Welding Limited.
detail: Aruna Bhagwan Advani submitted a formal disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. Regulation 31(4) mandates that any acquisition of shares crossing 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30%, 40%, 50%, 60%, 70%, 80%, 90% or 95% thresholds must be disclosed to the exchange and the target company. The filing date (19 June 2026) marks the regulated disclosure event. Specific shareholding percentage, consideration, acquisition method, and timeline details are not disclosed in the Bar & Bench article excerpt.
